chars.GIRL: GIRL: a Moroccan young woman about 20, long wavy dark brown hair, bright red lipstick, heavy makeup, wearing a fitted lilac satin blouse, white wide-leg trousers, small gold hoop earrings, holding a pink phone
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a skinny Moroccan young man about 22, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a dusty faded orange t-shirt, grey work trousers with black knee pads, white tile dust on his arms and hands

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from where the tiler kneels on the floor: GIRL leans in the doorway of the room mid-conversation, twirling her hair, smiling flirtatiously down at the viewer, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar, daylight from a large window opening.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR kneels on the half-tiled floor holding a trowel, frozen, eyes wide and one eyebrow raised in suspicion, glancing sideways, comic surprised expression, head-to-waist framing. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar, daylight from a large window opening.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: GIRL walks past very close in her lilac blouse, glamorous and dolled up, a visible swirl of perfume in the air; NARRATOR on his knees sniffs the air with his eyes half closed, stunned. Both faces visible. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar, daylight from a large window opening.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Comic shot: NARRATOR cuts a floor tile with an angle grinder, a cloud of white dust around him, sweaty, his dusty work socks visible, cartoon stink lines rising from his feet, embarrassed grimace. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar, daylight from a large window opening.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: GIRL stands in front of NARRATOR holding up her pink phone toward him with a shy, playful smile; NARRATOR, still holding a tile, stares at her with his mouth open in disbelief. Both faces visible, medium shot. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar, daylight from a large window opening.
